title: Tab bar set by the admin for everyone

panels.caption: Setup → Customization → Modules and Tabs → Organize Tabs

rows.b: Who the tab arrangement applies to
rows.zoho: Admin page in Setup → Modules and Tabs. Docs: a hidden module "won't appear regardless of user profile" (whole organisation). Not provable from one screenshot.
rows.tavi: Subtitle on screen: "Changes apply to you only." Each user arranges their own bar; the admin cannot set it for everyone.

rows.zoho: Drag to "Unselected Modules — Drop here to remove" (seen). Docs: at least one module must stay selected
rows.tavi: Eye icon per row; Tickets has a lock ("Always shown") so it cannot be hidden

rows.zoho: "Rename Tabs" sub-menu right under Organize Tabs (seen) — see item 2
rows.tavi: No Rename Tabs page; only Modules and Fields above Organize Tabs

notes: Row 1 Zoho behaviour is from Zoho's help article "Organizing and renaming modules" (customizing-help-desk-tabs); the on-screen Zoho page does not state the scope. Test K7 in the spec proves the TAVI side with a second user.
Tab order differs (Zoho: Contracts 3rd and an IM tab; TAVI: Contracts last, no IM) — order is configurable, IM belongs to the Instant Messaging channel; not part of this gap.
Originals (unannotated): originals/tavi/21-organize-tabs.png, originals/zoho/06-organize-tabs.png. Nothing was changed in either app.
